rationales.LC: In the default simulated configuration no model is called and MCP agents are tool servers invoked directly by callers; the documented proxy path is not implemented, so no natural-language path reaches a security-relevant sink.
rationales.CP: ProxyBot keeps no memory; the only cross-session store is MemoryBot's in-process list, which is unrelated to this path and does not alter standing behaviour.
rationales.AP: The effect is confined to the ProxyBot MCP tool server; no handoff to another agent, tenant, or policy domain occurs, and A2A handoffs are declared but not implemented.
rationales.RH: No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel is on the path; the scripted handlers return fixed results and no reward-hacking episode is observed or reachable.
rationales.ES: ProxyBot resolves any tool name with no authentication or schema constraint, and the tool binding surface is unvetted and dynamic.

score.automatable_rationale: The default configuration makes no proxy connection and no code changes the proxy URL; the documented MITM requires an attacker-controlled proxy endpoint or network position that is not present in the default run.
score.technical_impact_rationale: The scripted handlers return fixed results and no real signing keys or fund transfers occur; impact is limited to the simulated tool-call path.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: In the default simulated mode no model is called; ProxyBot is an MCP tool server that accepts any tool name and returns scripted results, with no model-directed goal pursuit or action selection.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab models ProxyBot as an MCP tool server invoked directly by callers; even in optional LLM mode no tools are passed to the model, so the agent does not pursue goals or sequence actions.
